result.description: Run the same scenario and assertions against independently scripted ITimerService/ITimerHandle mocks and both real services. Correct mock and deliberate negative responses must yield a green outer mock gate before product edits. Cover blocked cancellation registration, overlapping Restart against Stop and Dispose, new run after Stop, final Dispose, repeated shutdown, and reentrant calls.
result.title: Discriminating shared timer shutdown contract

acceptanceCriteria.text: Mock contract gate passes with zero failures/skips and rejects forbidden restart, stale token, and restart-after-dispose behaviors as expected negative controls.
The same contract tests pass against Core and UI.Core, and all four reproduced race cases no longer require external rescue.

Full five-project Manager suites, extension tests, and deployment-script tests have zero failures/skips before acceptance; deferred Claude HV must review all changed code/tests/docs before Phase 2 closure.
